verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a Drop-in Element, an embedded alternative to its Hosted Payment Page, that is created with createElement(...). It accepts appearance and layout options and adapts input fields to the payment method and country. Its docs also steer developers to the @airwallex/components-sdk and list embedded checkout and elements components for billing. Missing for 10: evidence of native mobile app SDKs (the 'app' part of the story), detail on granular per-field elements for payments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
